accessibility.title: Worker runtime guardrail flow
accessibility.description: The diagram shows the backend installing the worker runtime in shadow mode, validating manifests, restricting scoped Worker DB commands, and only allowing production actions after cutover gates are met. If the gates are not met, production writes stay off and legacy ingestion remains the owner.
